title: Cosmic Cliffs of Carina (JWST)
explanation: The "Cosmic Cliffs" — towering peaks of gas and dust in NGC 3324 sculpted by the fierce radiation of hot young stars.

title: Pillars of Creation (JWST)
explanation: JWST's near-infrared portrait of the iconic Pillars of Creation in M16 — towering columns of cool gas where new stars are born.

title: Pillars of Creation (Hubble)
explanation: Hubble's celebrated 2015 visible-light view of the Pillars of Creation.

title: The Milky Way over Paranal
explanation: The full arch of the Milky Way over ESO's Paranal Observatory in the Atacama Desert.

title: Journey to a Galaxy Cluster
explanation: Hubble peers into the heart of a rich galaxy cluster, recording thousands of galaxies spanning billions of light-years.

title: ESO Deep Field
explanation: A deep-sky exposure from ESO's Very Large Telescope reveals thousands of faint galaxies.
